commands.name: verify
commands.help: Verify an exported audit evidence bundle (directory or .zip) offline.

parser.description:
Recompute every leaf hash, check hash-chain linkage and Merkle roots,
and verify Ed25519 signatures against the bundle's public keys, with
zero network. Those keys come from the bundle, so trust in the
producing server drops out only at VERIFIED, ATTESTED, which needs the
signing keys to chain to the pinned CogNEXUS Evidence Root. This
release pins no Evidence Root: an intact bundle reports
VERIFIED, SELF-ATTESTED unless --root-fingerprint supplies a test root.
Download a bundle from GET /api/v1/audit/export. Signature checks
require 'artzain[verify]'.

actions.help: show this help message and exit

Emit a JSON result.
Override the pinned CogNEXUS Evidence Root fingerprint (test roots only — the output states when a non-default root is in use).

commands.name: sidecar
commands.help: Run the sidecar beside an OpenShell gateway (HTTP, loopback).

parser.description:
Runs the ArtzAIn sidecar beside an OpenShell gateway. It answers
the gateway's interceptor calls from the ArtzAIn Decision API,
lists sandboxes for the catalog and seals OpenShell policy events.
It only ever calls out to the engine.

Settings (environment):
  OPENSHELL_SIDECAR_GRPC    where the gateway calls the interceptor:
      unix:///absolute/path or a loopback host:port
      (needs: pip install 'artzain[openshell]')
  OPENSHELL_JWT_PUBLIC_KEY / OPENSHELL_JWT_GATEWAY_ID  the gateway's
      gateway_jwt public key file and id; every call must then carry
      the gateway's signed token
  OPENSHELL_SIDECAR_HOST / OPENSHELL_SIDECAR_PORT  HTTP bind address
      (default 127.0.0.1:8088)
  OPENSHELL_SIDECAR_TOKEN   bearer every request must carry
  OPENSHELL_GATEWAY_ID      this gateway; names every decision
  ARTZAIN_DECISION_URL      engine origin (http or https)
  COGNEXUS_API_KEY          Decision API key
  OPENSHELL_SIDECAR_DECIDE_TIMEOUT_MS  engine deadline
      (default 1200; keep it below the gateway's interceptor timeout)

Operator steps: the ArtzAIn operator manual, chapter 17.

commands.name: openshell
commands.help: Bind this host's OpenShell gateway (deb or rpm, systemd user service).

parser.description:
Binds the OpenShell gateway on this host to ArtzAIn, and undoes it.

  up      swap an enroll token for the gateway's credential, install the
          sidecar as a systemd user service, add the interceptor
          registration to gateway.toml, restart the gateway and check
          that a write ArtzAIn denies is refused. Run it again to
          finish a run that stopped.
  remove  put gateway.toml and gateway.env back as they were, remove
          the sidecar, restart the gateway unbound and revoke the
          credential.
  status  what is installed, and whether it is up (JSON).
  rotate-key  swap the gateway's credential for a new one; the sidecar
          and the gateway restart, and the old credential is revoked.
  doctor  check the services, the socket, the credential file, the
          registration, the OpenShell release, the engine through the
          proxy and the clock; exits 1 when a check fails.

The enroll token is read from ARTZAIN_ENROLL_TOKEN.
Operator steps: the ArtzAIn operator manual, chapter 17.
